CREATE TYPE "UserRole" AS ENUM (
  'STANDARD',
  'PRESTATAIRE'
);

CREATE TYPE "ServiceStatus" AS ENUM (
  'EN_ATTENTE',
  'VALIDE',
  'REFUSE'
);

CREATE TYPE "AnnonceStatus" AS ENUM (
  'ACTIVE',
  'EN_COURS',
  'RESOLUE',
  'EXPIREE'
);

CREATE TYPE "NotificationType" AS ENUM (
  'DEMANDE',
  'FEEDBACK',
  'SERVICE_VALIDE',
  'SERVICE_REFUSE'
);

CREATE TYPE "PropositionStatus" AS ENUM (
  'EN_ATTENTE',
  'ACCEPTEE',
  'REFUSEE'
);


CREATE TABLE "Localisation" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "latitude" DECIMAL,
  "longitude" DECIMAL,
  "ville" VARCHAR,
  "quartier" VARCHAR,
  "adresse" VARCHAR
);


CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "nom" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "prenom" VARCHAR,
  "email" VARCHAR UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  "mot_de_passe" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'STANDARD',
  "photo_profil" VARCHAR,
  "bio" TEXT,
  "telephone" VARCHAR,
  "localisation_id" INT,
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "date_modification" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE TABLE "Categorie" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "nom" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "icone" VARCHAR
);


CREATE TABLE "Service" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "prestataire_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "categorie_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "localisation_id" INT,
  "titre" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "tarif" DECIMAL,
  "statut" "ServiceStatus" DEFAULT 'EN_ATTENTE',
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "date_modification" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE TABLE "ServiceImage" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "service_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "url_image" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "ordre" INT
);


CREATE TABLE "Feedback" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "service_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "auteur_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "note" INT,
  "commentaire" TEXT,
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE TABLE "Annonce" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "demandeur_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "categorie_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "localisation_id" INT,
  "titre" VARCHAR NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "statut" "AnnonceStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  "date_expiration" TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE TABLE "PropositionAnnonce" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "annonce_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "utilisateur_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "message" TEXT,
  "statut" "PropositionStatus" DEFAULT 'EN_ATTENTE',
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE TABLE "Notification" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  "user_id" INT NOT NULL,
  "type" "NotificationType",
  "titre" VARCHAR,
  "contenu" TEXT,
  "vu" BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  "date_creation" TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);


CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "unique_feedback"
ON "Feedback" ("service_id", "auteur_id");


-- Relations

ALTER TABLE "users"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("localisation_id")
REFERENCES "Localisation" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Service"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("prestataire_id")
REFERENCES "users" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Service"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("categorie_id")
REFERENCES "Categorie" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Service"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("localisation_id")
REFERENCES "Localisation" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "ServiceImage"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("service_id")
REFERENCES "Service" ("id")
ON DELETE CASCADE;


ALTER TABLE "Feedback"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("service_id")
REFERENCES "Service" ("id")
ON DELETE CASCADE;


ALTER TABLE "Feedback"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("auteur_id")
REFERENCES "users" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Annonce"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("demandeur_id")
REFERENCES "users" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Annonce"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("categorie_id")
REFERENCES "Categorie" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Annonce"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("localisation_id")
REFERENCES "Localisation" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "PropositionAnnonce"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("annonce_id")
REFERENCES "Annonce" ("id")
ON DELETE CASCADE;


ALTER TABLE "PropositionAnnonce"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("utilisateur_id")
REFERENCES "users" ("id");


ALTER TABLE "Notification"
ADD FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
REFERENCES "users" ("id")
ON DELETE CASCADE;
